column1: # Second sweep of UI literals, from the reference-screenshot report.
# Same rules as 06: these are FORCED SUBSTRINGS (applied inside longer text),
# and ␣ stands for a literal space. Longest-first ordering is applied at build
# time, so "黑暗森林" (Dark Forest) still beats the bare "黑暗" below.
# These were skipped in the first pass on the assumption they would compose
# from the morpheme glossary, but those entries are exact-match only and a
# badge is a single node, so nothing ever matched.
# V3.46's placeholder Great Verdant King wears a LETTERSPACED badge -
# "准 微 尘 级" with real spaces between the glyphs - so none of the
# compact realm keys above can reach it. Its own entry, spacing dropped:
# English is already wide and "Q u a s i" would only look broken.
# sub-ranks: "微尘级初级" -> "Dust-Tier Basic". These exist in 00_morphemes but
# only as exact matches, so they never fired inside a composed badge.

column3: skill bar; scoped with the colon so the 合成 Craft button is untouched

column1: # The category name is spliced into a longer node, and all 13 names are
# EXACT-only (`component` rows in 00_morphemes.tsv; file 00 is not a
# forced-fragment file), so none could resolve - every crafting dropdown
# read "Select one [轮锋]". Scoped by the brackets on purpose: 轮芯 also
# appears inside compound item names (凝胶轮芯 = Gel Wheel Hub), and a bare
# fragment could split those when the compound itself is not a key.
# --- v10.0: found by the project-wide embedded-name sweep ---
# display.js: `x${mult} ${MulNameMap[k]} 经验获取`. MulNameMap is
# {"all":"全部","hero":"等级","all skill":"技能"}. 等级 resolves; 全部 and
# 技能 do NOT - both are deliberately non-global (全部 is a v4.0 button
# pair, 技能 as a bare fragment breaks "秘法 技能" -> Technique Skills).
# Scoped to this readout by including 经验获取, so neither escapes it.
# The "no stance" entry in combat_stances.js. Bracket-scoped: bare 无 is a
# common character and must never become a fragment.
# `环境 : <span id="engine_result_temp">` - concatenated, so a fragment.
# The leave button is 155px wide. "离开" + "极寒相变引擎" composed to
# "LeaveDeepfrost Phase-Change Engine" - no space (离开 carries none) and far
# too wide. One entry for the whole label instead; you are already inside
# the engine, so naming it again is redundant.
# --- v10.5: Blazing Sun blessing time periods ---
# main.js: `目前的时段为 ${MM1[C_time]}，` - the whole line is one node, so the
# rule fires and inserts the period as $1 verbatim, leaving "23-45点".
# Listed explicitly (the array is a fixed 8 values) rather than making 点 a
# fragment - 点 is far too common (点伤害, 点数, 一点...) to risk globally.
# A Bloodfall day runs 0-180, so these are hours.
# V3.44 rank phases. Keyed WITH the separator, so the spacing matches the
# game's other dot-joined names ("C1 · Energy Core") and a bare 前期/后期
# cannot fire inside ordinary prose, where both are common words.
